title: Sebi proposes limiting tenure of chief executives, independent directors at exchanges
summary: India's Securities and Exchange Board is proposing crucial adjustments to governance norms affecting market institutions. Current executives can finish their ongoing terms despite these proposed changes. SEBI is seeking public feedback on these recommendations by December 11.
